description:
The public wide carry-less multiplication functions in gf2-core run the portable scalar schoolbook for every operand width, bypassing the capability-dispatched kernels that gf2's own wide-field arithmetic already uses.

## Background

`gf2m::wide::clmul_wide` delegates to `clmul_wide_slice`, which multiplies every word pair through the portable bit-by-bit carry-less product. The dispatching helper that selects the PCLMULQDQ kernels for 4-word and 9-word operands is crate-private and serves wide-field multiplication and the wide Barrett reducer, so a caller of the documented public long-product API never reaches an accelerated path. An exploratory measurement at four words found the public path far slower than the dispatched kernel. The `Gf2mWide::mul_ref` rustdoc also names the public function as its mechanism, although its body uses the private helper.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.
- [hard] REQ-02: The public wide carry-less product functions reach the same capability-dispatched kernels as gf2's internal wide-field multiplication on hosts that support them and keep the tested portable scalar fallback elsewhere, through one canonical dispatch path shared by public and internal callers.
- [hard] REQ-03: The shared carry-less product conformance suite covers the public functions at dispatched and non-dispatched widths with random and adversarial operands, comparing complete double-width outputs against the portable oracle, including the scalar fallback.
- [hard] REQ-04: A frozen before/after receipt measures the public path at dispatched and non-dispatched widths, including dispatch overhead at small widths, and production adoption follows the frozen non-regression rule.
- [hard] REQ-05: The rustdoc of the public functions and of `Gf2mWide::mul_ref` states the mechanism and complexity each actually uses.

## Notes

Surfaced by the polynomial-multiplication baseline survey, whose source evidence records the call paths. No multiplication algorithm change is part of this task.
title: Route the public wide carry-less product through capability dispatch
